day_shape: 55 items: active US-Iran hostilities with reported strikes near Bandar Abbas and Shiraz, Iran-claimed attacks on US sites in Bahrain/Kuwait, two Dynacom tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz corridor, Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya political bureau chief, and State Dept launches Lebanon pilot zones in Froun/Srifa/Zawtar Al-Gharbiya.

threads.label: US-Iran strikes and Gulf shipping
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported US strikes near Bandar Abbas targeting Iran's shipping-threat capabilities and said Greek operator Dynacom Tankers had two vessels hit by projectiles in the US-facilitated southern Strait of Hormuz corridor. IRIB and Defa Press claimed a US air attack on Shiraz caused no casualties, while the US is reportedly sending additional F-16, F-35 and refuelling aircraft to the region.

threads.label: Iran-claimed attacks on Gulf and Jordan
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iran claimed to have struck US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait with sirens sounding in both countries, and reported dozens of US soldiers wounded in Jordan attacks with only a few disclosed by CENTCOM. Defa Press and IRIB amplified an IRGC claim of "simultaneous attacks on three axes" and thanked "honorable people of Jordan" for intelligence support.

threads.label: Mediation and diplomatic overtures
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported mediators proposed a 10-day US-Iran ceasefire, with Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei confirming new mediator ideas at a press conference and Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying the US remains open to a diplomatic solution. France's Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said two French embassy employees in Tehran were harassed, detained and interrogated by Iranian security forces on Sunday.

threads.label: Lebanon pilot zones launch
threads.summary: The US State Department announced pilot zone operations began in Froun, Srifa and Zawtar Al-Gharbiya under the Trilateral Framework agreed in Rome last week, with the Lebanese Armed Forces set to test disarming Hezbollah. Times of Israel noted Froun and Srifa lie outside the IDF's south Lebanon buffer zone, and the Israeli government began advertising new homes in 28 frontline northern communities including Shtula.

threads.label: Hamas leadership and Gaza
threads.summary: Hamas named Khalil al-Hayya, its wartime chief negotiator, as new head of the political bureau succeeding Yahya al-Sinwar, with Palestinian Islamic Jihad calling the appointment a sign of "strength and cohesion." IDF said a PIJ operative involved in the October 7 Nova festival abduction of Inbar Haim was killed in a Friday strike in central Gaza, while Jerusalem Post reported Palestinians accusing Hamas of hijacking aid at food distribution points.

events.summary:
A Palestinian Islamic Jihad terrorist who took part in the attack on the Nova music festival during the October 7, 2023, onslaught was killed in an Israeli strike over the weekend, the military announces.

The IDF says the strike on Friday in the central Gaza Strip killed Taher Ahmad Salem Abd al-Wahed, who on October 7 "infiltrated the Nova music festival and commanded the abduction of Inbar Haiman."

Haiman, 27, from Haifa, was captured and murdered by terrorists while fleeing the music festival, and her body was taken to Gaza. Her remains were returned to Israel by Hamas in October 2025.

events.title_en: Securitisation of New York following explosion and clashes at Federal Plaza; complete closure of incident area in New York
events.summary_en: Securitisation of New York following explosion and clashes at Federal Plaza; complete closure of incident area in New York. A security incident occurred in front of the Federal Plaza building in New York City, resulting in the evacuation of the building and a large deployment of police forces. The New York Police confirmed that the incident involved a combination of shooting and use of explosives. Immediately after the incident, federal and police officers arrived at the scene and succeeded in apprehending the perpetrator of the attack. Pavements and streets leading to the building have been closed and a full evacuation order has been issued.
